name: Missing email validation on contact form
description: Submitting the contact form with an invalid email address succeeds without showing an error message.

name: Broken navigation link in navbar
description: The 'Pricing' link in the top navigation bar links to /pricing-old.html which returns 404.

name: Unhandled TypeError on catalog filter
description: Clicking the 'Filter by Category' button causes an unhandled TypeError in the browser console.

name: Cart quantity allows negative values
description: Clicking the decrement button when quantity is 1 sets quantity to -1 and produces negative total price.

name: Missing accessible name on submit button
description: The primary newsletter subscribe button is an icon button without an aria-label or accessible text.

matcher.expected_condition: Interactive button has no accessible text or aria-label

name: Modal overlay intercepts checkout button click
description: An invisible overlay with high z-index covers the 'Place Order' button preventing click events.

name: Repeated promo code application produces negative balance
description: Applying promo code SAVE20 multiple times continuously deducts discount without checking if already applied.

matcher.expected_condition: Total amount is negative after reapplying promo code

name: Logout button unhandled promise rejection in console
description: Clicking the logout button fails to navigate and throws an unhandled Promise rejection in console.

matcher.expected_condition: Console logs unhandled promise rejection on logout
